validationChecklist.q: Is OneSite scheduled or already live?
Has the property for mirroring the Screening scoring model been identified?
Can Accounting Entity, Payments setup, Knock, Website setup, Contact Center Answer Automation, or eSupply begin early?
Is OneSite live before activating Payments?
Is OneSite live before launching Loft Living, Online Renewals, Syndication, Contact Center Leasing, and Contact Center Missed Maintenance?
Is Payments activated before launching Loft Leasing?
Are Loft Loyalty and Loft Moving scheduled three to five days after Loft Living?
Is the property date current before beginning BI and Performance Analytics setup?
Are OneSite, Loft Living, Loft Leasing, and Knock live before completing Website integration?
Have all required product integrations been included in the implementation timeline?

products.name: RUM / RUSM (RealPage Utility and Sustainability Management)
products.requiresSrc: <TODO: RUM/RUSM is absent from the Product Dependency Reference table. The OneSite prerequisite is inferred from the Project Planning Process deck timeline, not stated as a dependency. Confirm with SME before a learner relies on it.>

RB: Utility bills the client wants to bill back
Supporting information — SUBS: submeter information; RUBS: amount
UEM: Utility bills the client wants RealPage to pay
Letter of Authorization on company letterhead
VCR: Utility bills the client wants transferred to the residents' names

products.timeline: Deliverables are due the 15th of the current month, or the 15th of the following month if past that. The build month is always a full month following the due month, despite the ICD date. First bills activate the 1st day of the month following the build month.
products.clientQuestion: When will you be able to provide utility bills and a lease with utility addendum?
products.caution: Utility bills should be under the property name, not the construction company (for new construction)
products.note: Usually the last to be implemented because transferring ownership for utility accounts takes time
products.src: Project Planning Process deck, slide 3 (Timeline)
